meta.name: add-karpathy-llm-wiki
meta.description: Add a persistent wiki knowledge base to a NanoClaw group. Based on Karpathy's LLM Wiki pattern. Triggers on "add wiki", "wiki", "knowledge base", "llm wiki", "karpathy wiki".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为群组添加持久化知识库
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在群聊中共享和查询持久化的知识库内容。
copy.tagline_en: Add a persistent wiki knowledge base to your group
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to share and query a persistent knowledge base in group chats.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会在 NanoClaw 群里搭一个持久 wiki 知识库:建 wiki/、sources/ 目录与初始 index.md、log.md,生成维护 wiki 的容器技能,并在群的 CLAUDE.md 里加一段 wiki 说明。
howto.when: 当你提到 “add wiki”“wiki” 等词,或要求给某个群添加持久知识库时触发;可选主群、新建专用群或已有群。

say.text: 给这个群加一个 wiki 知识库
say.note: 先读 Karpathy 模式,再问选哪个群

say.text: 用 karpathy wiki 模式在专用群里建知识库
say.note: 会新建一个只放 wiki 的群

say.text: 给 wiki 安排每周一次的健康检查

howto.what_en: After install, Claude sets up a persistent wiki knowledge base in a NanoClaw group: creates wiki/ and sources/ folders with initial index.md and log.md, writes a maintenance container skill, and adds a wiki section to the group's CLAUDE.md.
howto.when_en: Triggers on "add wiki", "wiki" and similar phrases, or when you ask to add a persistent knowledge base to a group. You choose the main, a new dedicated, or an existing group.

say_en.text: Add a wiki knowledge base to this group
say_en.note: Reads the Karpathy pattern, then asks which group

say_en.text: Set up a karpathy wiki in a dedicated group
say_en.note: Creates a new group just for the wiki

say_en.text: Schedule a weekly lint for the wiki
